svg.title: One saddle, two rivers
svg.desc: Schematic of the drainage either side of Kunzum La. West of the pass water goes to the Chandra and becomes the Chenab; east of it water goes to the Spiti and joins the Sutlej at Khab. The two rejoin at Uch Sharif as the Panjnad and reach the Indus at Mithankot. The 2026 drive is overlaid as a dashed line.
svg.text: Not a map — the plumbing. Every stream on this page ends in the same sea.
Sutlej and Chenab become the Panjnad
from Kailash, by way of Ladakh
Two of the five rivers of the Punjab. Their headwaters lie a few hundred metres apart
across one saddle; their water meets again about a thousand kilometres later. You drive
four days against the current, cross, and spend one day going with it.
